title: Full Day Prosecco Wine Tasting at Two Wineries from Venice
overview: Prosecco is Italy’s most beloved bubbly, produced on the scenic slopes just north of Venice. Make exploring beyond city limits simple—and head to wineries you might not find on your own—on this full-day, private tour. Enjoy a scenic drive through rolling vineyards and medieval villages from Venice to two wine estates for tours, wine tastings, and a light lunch overlooking the hills.
startDescription: Piazzale Roma, 30135 Venezia VE, Italy. In front of the Pullman bar. 10:00 am departure.
notes: Live USD From$190.00; 5.0/155; wine premium. No numbered What To Expect POIs; used Piazzale Roma meeting point and Prosecco Hills wineries as verified location names.

overview: Beat the crowds and enjoy an insider's introduction to Venice during this private photo walk, which visits lesser-known neighborhoods and attractions that only locals know. title: FriendInVenice Murano Burano Torcello Private Tour By Luxury Boat
overview: Venice’s “vaporetto” water buses are a unique way to get around the islands, but their slow pace and frequent stops can eat into your sightseeing time. With this tour, zip between the islands by water taxi and fit in guided visits to three of the most fascinating in a single day. Explore Murano’s glassblowing workshops, snap photos of Burano’s colorful houses, and learn about Venetian history on Torcello.
inclusions: Back to Venice by private water taxi
startDescription: Hotel, seaport, airport, or train-station pickup according to booking details. 10:30 am start.
notes: Live USD From$1,322.82; 4.9/19; private luxury boat. Island POI titles from the live overview.

title: Venice In a Day: Basilica San Marco, Doges Palace & Gondola ride
overview: Ideal for first-time visitors, this full-day tour of Venice checks off all the most-important attractions. Stroll across the Rialto Bridge and browse the lively Rialto fish market, then hop aboard a traditional gondola for a romantic cruise along the Grand Canal. Finally, visit St. Mark's Basilica and enjoy skip-the-line entrance to the grandiose Doge's Palace.
inclusions: Skip-the-line ticket for St. Mark's Basilica
Pre-reserved ticket to the Doge's Palace
startDescription: Campo S. Giacomo di Rialto, 255, 30125 Venezia VE, Italy. Meet outside the entrance of the Church of San Giacometto. Guide holds a green Walks sign.
notes: Live USD From$149.38; 4.8/2865 from Reviews section; longer guided sightseeing. Skipped the weak 'Venice' itinerary heading.

title: Venice: St Mark's Basilica After-Hours Tour with Optional Doge's Palace
overview: Experience the magic of Venice's St. Mark's Basilica with an exclusive after-hours, small-group tour. Marvel at the breathtaking mosaics, explore the crypt believed to house St. Mark's remains, and soak in the serene atmosphere without the daytime crowds. For an extended adventure, upgrade to include a visit to the Doge's Palace, the historic seat of the Venetian Republic’s government.

Small groups of 25 people or fewer

overview: Delve into two of Venice’s most remarkable sights without the fast pace and set itinerary of a group tour with this private visit to the Doge's Palace and Saint Mark's Basilica. Bypass the long line with priority admission and head directly inside with your guide. Marvel at the glittering mosaics, then take in the sumptuous halls, historic prisons, and Bridge of Sighs in the palace.

title: Private Excursion by Typical Venetian Motorboat to Murano, Burano and Torcello
overview: Discover three of the most beautiful islands in the Venetian Lagoon on a private, half-day tour aboard a typical Venetian motorboat. See where the world’s finest blown glass is made in Murano, visit the home of artisan lace makers and famous biscuits in Burano and set foot on Venice’s oldest settlements in serene Torcello. Enjoy a customizable itinerary and the personalized attention of a private boat captain.
startDescription: Local guide meets you at the lobby of your hotel in Venice.
notes: Live USD From$205.26; 4.6/403; private motorboat islands. Distinct from 126511P4 luxury water-taxi day.

title: Dolomite Mountains and Cortina Semi Private Day Trip from Venice
overview: Get out of Venice for the day to visit the magnificent Dolomite Mountains. The early departure is to ensure a better experience in an area that year after year has seen a growing number of visitors. Enjoy the luxury of having a driver to seamlessly transport you between sites, which, depending on the season, may include Cortina d’Ampezzo, Lake Misurina and enjoy stunning views of the Tre Cime di Lavaredo peaks.

overview: Eating great food is a highlight of visiting Italy, but, in Venice, many visitors fall for subpar tourist traps. Avoid that risk by joining this small-group secret food walking tour. You'll stroll the city's atmospheric streets while sampling a variety of dishes perfected by local eateries and learning about Venetian life and culinary history.

title: Murano & Burano Islands Guided Small-Group Tour by Private Boat
overview: Explore the intricacies of two famed Italian handicrafts on a fully guided day trip from Venice to the nearby islands of Murano and Burano with a group of up to 22 people. Watch centuries-old glassblowing techniques in Murano, and marvel at the detailed stitches of exquisite Burano lace. Your knowledgeable guide will share the history of these two artisan islands while you visit local workshops and wander the picturesque streets.
inclusions: Round-trip transportation by private boat just for your group
startDescription: Riva degli Schiavoni, 4110, 30122 Venezia VE, Italy. In front of Hotel Gabrielli Sandwirth (near San Marco).

title: Venetian Cicchetti Street Food & Sightseeing Walking Tour with local guide
overview: Go for a sightseeing tour of Venice, and discover the city’s local culinary culture, too—this two-in-one tour provides an enviable way to explore. Meet your guide in the morning at the Church of San Salvador, and set off on foot. You’ll discover major landmarks like the Rialto Bridge, Campo San Polo, and Basilica dei Frari. You’ll also drop by Venice’s authentic bacari to nibble cicchetti (street food snacks), soak up the atmosphere, and even enjoy a beverage or two, if preferred (own expense).
startDescription: Campo San Bortolomio, Campo S. Bortolomio, 30124 Venezia VE, Italy. Meet next to the statue. Guide holds a Food Tour sign.
